messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (federal holidays that create a 3‑day weekend, plus the New Year’s weekend which is a 2‑day holiday but still often treated as a “long” weekend).  

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Sunday & Monday – 2‑day weekend (often counted as a long weekend). |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (observed Feb 20) | Saturday–Monday (only in provinces that observe Family Day). |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (observed Apr 7) | Friday–Sunday – 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (observed May 22) | Saturday–Monday – 3‑day weekend. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Saturday–Monday – 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (observed Sep 4) | Saturday–Monday – 3‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (observed Oct 9) | Saturday–Monday – 3‑day weekend. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Saturday–Monday – 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day (observed Dec 25) | Saturday–Monday – 3‑day weekend. |

> **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** falls on a Tuesday in 2023, so it does not form a long weekend on its own.

These are the federal holidays that give Canadians a 3‑day break (or a 2‑day break in the case of New Year’s). If you’re targeting a specific province, you may want to add any provincial holidays that fall on a weekday and create a similar weekend. Happy planning!
